segments.source: A Boolean value that indicates the readiness of the layer to accept more sample buffers.
segments.ko: 레이어가 추가 sample buffer를 수락할 준비 상태를 나타내는 부울 값입니다.

segments.source: Apple discourages the use of this symbol in iOS 17, tvOS 17, and macOS 14 and later.
segments.ko: Apple은 iOS 17, tvOS 17 및 macOS 14 이상에서 이 기호 사용을 권장하지 않습니다.

segments.source: `AVSampleBufferDisplayLayer` keeps track of the occupancy levels of its internal queues for the benefit of clients that enqueue sample buffers from non-real-time sources — that is, clients that can supply sample buffers faster than they are consumed and need to decide when to hold back buffers.
segments.ko: `AVSampleBufferDisplayLayer`는 내부 큐의 점유 수준을 추적하여 비실시간 소스에서 sample buffer를 큐에 넣는 클라이언트에 이점을 제공합니다. 즉, sample buffer를 소모 속도보다 빠르게 제공하며 버퍼 보류 시점을 결정해야 하는 클라이언트를 위한 기능입니다.

segments.source: Clients enqueueing sample buffers from non-real-time sources may hold off from generating or obtaining more sample buffers to enqueue when the value of `readyForMoreMediaData` is [`false`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/false).
segments.ko: 비실시간 소스에서 샘플 버퍼를 enqueue하는 클라이언트는 `readyForMoreMediaData` 값이 [`false`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/false)일 때 추가로 enqueue할 샘플 버퍼를 생성하거나 가져오는 작업을 보류할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: It is safe to call [`enqueue(_:)`](avsamplebufferdisplaylayer/enqueue(_:).md) when [`isReadyForMoreMediaData`](avsamplebufferdisplaylayer/isreadyformoremediadata.md) is [`false`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/false), but enqueing more sample buffers than are required for timely rendering by the receiver is highly discouraged.
segments.ko: It is safe to call [`enqueue(_:)`](avsamplebufferdisplaylayer/enqueue(_:).md) when [`isReadyForMoreMediaData`](avsamplebufferdisplaylayer/isreadyformoremediadata.md) is [`false`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/false), but enqueing more sample buffers than are required for timely rendering by the receiver is highly discouraged.

segments.source: To help with control of the non-real-time supply of sample buffers, such clients should use [`requestMediaDataWhenReady(on:using:)`](avsamplebufferdisplaylayer/requestmediadatawhenready(on:using:).md) in order to specify a block that the layer should invoke whenever it’s ready for sample buffers to be appended.
segments.ko: 비실시간 샘플 버퍼 공급을 제어하려면 이러한 클라이언트가 샘플 버퍼를 추가할 준비가 되면 레이어가 호출할 블록을 지정하도록 [`requestMediaDataWhenReady(on:using:)`](avsamplebufferdisplaylayer/requestmediadatawhenready(on:using:).md)를 사용해야 합니다.

segments.source: The value of `readyForMoreMediaData` will often change from [`false`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/false) to [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true) asynchronously, as previously supplied sample buffers are decoded and displayed.
segments.ko: `readyForMoreMediaData`의 값은 이전에 제공된 샘플 버퍼가 디코딩되고 표시되면 [`false`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/false)에서 [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true)로 비동기적으로 바뀌는 경우가 자주 있습니다.

segments.source: ❗ **Important**: This property does not support key-value observing.
segments.ko: ❗ **중요**: 이 속성은 key-value observing을 지원하지 않습니다.

segments.source: Instructs the target to invoke a client-supplied block repeatedly, at its convenience, in order to gather sample buffers for display.
segments.ko: 대상은 디스플레이용 샘플 버퍼를 수집하기 위해 클라이언트가 제공한 블록을 필요할 때마다 반복해서 호출하도록 지시합니다.

segments.source: A Boolean value that indicates whether the layer needs to flush its state to continue decoding frames.
segments.ko: 레이어가 프레임을 계속 디코딩하려면 상태를 플러시해야 하는지 나타내는 부울 값입니다.

segments.source: Cancels any current media data request.
segments.ko: 현재 미디어 데이터 요청을 모두 취소합니다.

segments.source: A Boolean value that indicates whether the enqueued media data meets the renderer’s preroll level.
segments.ko: 큐에 추가된 미디어 데이터가 렌더러의 preroll 수준을 충족하는지를 나타내는 부울 값입니다.
